title: Intersecting TSDB postings lists is slow: redundant Seeks and binary searches dominate the intersection hot loop

source.license_note: Real upstream prometheus optimization PR #17439; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up intersection of TSDB index postings lists by eliminating redundant Seek calls and binary searches in the intersectPostings.Next and ListPostings.Seek hot paths.
task.instructions: Optimize the tsdb/index package for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkIntersect measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: intersectPostings.Next always falls through to a full Seek and ListPostings.Seek always runs slices.BinarySearch even when the next element already matches.

ops_fault.description: Profiling shows CPU concentrated in postings intersection: repeated Seek and binary-search work on aligned posting iterators.
detection_keywords: high CPU in intersection hot loop
repair_keywords: fast-path allEqual to skip redundant Seek
advance first posting then match others
check next list item before binary search
track at vs target to defer Seek

visible_context.issue_text: Intersecting several postings lists in the TSDB index is CPU-bound; the intersection loop spends a lot of time re-seeking iterators and binary-searching lists that are already aligned.
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization; profiling diagnosis injected as upstream context.
